SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(a.TRADEDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `交易日期`,
    a.STOCKSNAME AS `股票名称`,
    c.SEC_CODE AS `股票代码`,
    ROUND(a.TCLOSE, 2) AS `收盘价（元）`
FROM 
    STK_MKT a
JOIN 
    GET_A_SEC_CODE c
    ON a.INNER_CODE = c.INNER_CODE
WHERE 
    a.ISVALID = 1
    AND a.STOCKSNAME LIKE '%招商银行%'
    AND c.SEC_SNAME LIKE '%招商银行%'
    AND a.TRADEDATE = '2026-09-01'
    AND a.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL
